text: きみきみ　しってるかい？

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: しってる is the shortened spoken form of しっている. With this verb ている means the state of knowing. しってる = 'know'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい is a friendly, rather manly way of asking a yes-or-no question, softer than か. しってるかい = 'do you know?'.
